research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Indictable prosecutions change
verified_claims: Prosecutions for indictable offences increased by 9%, the highest level since 2016.
limitations: Court flow cannot be converted into a parcel risk value.

sources.name: Magistrates remand custody total
verified_claims: The number remanded in custody at magistrates' courts rose to 67,000.
limitations: Court remand totals are not local crime occurrence data.

sources.name: Magistrates remand custody share
verified_claims: The proportion remanded in custody at magistrates' courts remained about 5%.
limitations: A national court proportion has no exact parcel attribution.

sources.name: Average custodial sentence change
verified_claims: Average custodial sentence length fell slightly for all offences and indictable offences.
limitations: Sentence length reflects sentencing composition, not parcel safety.

sources.name: Motoring prosecutions total
limitations: Court prosecutions are not a road-risk measure for an individual parcel.

sources.name: Motoring prosecutions change
verified_claims: Motoring prosecutions increased by 5% and reached a ten-year high.
limitations: National prosecution growth can reflect enforcement and recording activity.

sources.name: Common motoring groups share
verified_claims: Insurance, registration and excise, and speed-limit offences accounted for 65% of motoring prosecutions.
limitations: The offence mix does not establish conditions at a specific address.

sources.name: Revision guard
verified_claims: Previously published figures may be revised when additional data become available.
limitations: Provisional or revisable figures must not be treated as immutable parcel evidence.

sources.name: One Crown data model
verified_claims: The One Crown project created a single consistent dataset for MoJ and HMCTS criminal court statistics.
limitations: Data-model coherence does not create spatial parcel resolution.

sources.name: One Crown remand reinstatement
verified_claims: Crown Court remand data were reinstated after final work on remand status.
limitations: Series reinstatement does not imply parcel-level completeness.
